title: The UK is conducting a full review of its NHS contract with Palantir, amid growing pressure to terminate the deal in 2027 over reliance on US tech companies (Sam Tabahriti/Reuters)
summary: Sam Tabahriti / Reuters: The UK is conducting a full review of its NHS contract with Palantir, amid growing pressure to terminate the deal in 2027 over reliance on US tech companies — Britain is conducting a full review of its National Health Service contract with U.S. data analytics firm Palantir (PLTR.O) …
